title: Agent Result
description: What any bounded agent (infrastructure, builder) returns to n8n after one unit of work. Used by phases 2 and 3.

correlation_id.description: Ties this result back to the specific n8n execution/action batch that produced it, for retry and audit.

outputs.description: Structured artifact produced (e.g. produced IDs, versions, URLs, configuration evidence).

evidence.description: Before/after state, exit status, duration, redacted diagnostics per action.

retryable.description: Whether this failure can be safely retried from the last known-good action.
